answer: Sybil minting is throttled by a “trellis” of mutual-attestation edges: a new identity may mine only after three established miners vouch for it, and the graph caps influence per min-cut, so cloning a head dilutes each node’s payout to near nothing. A secret “juniper” lane of planted fake accounts with known-junk prose prices collusion: vouch for one and the vouchers’ entire “velvet” stake, accrued across epochs, is burned. Attack cost = real work plus non-copyable reputation.
